What JB Catalogue does

A catalogue that looks like your shop, not a marketplace

Your own address

Your own domain or subdomain, your logo and colours. No other shops listed alongside yours.

Every piece, shown properly

Several photos per product, zoom, weight variants, and today's gold rate for reference.

Wishlist & enquiry list

Optional, saved in the shopper's own browser — no account needed to browse.

WhatsApp enquiries

A shopper's question opens straight in WhatsApp, addressed to your shop's number.

Live rate strip

Today's gold and silver rate, shown on the catalogue so shoppers always see current pricing.

Built for a phone

Most shoppers arrive on a phone: a bottom bar for Home, Collections, Search, Ring Size, Rate and Profile.

How it works

From browsing to a sale at the counter

JB Catalogue shows the shop's designs online; the sale itself still happens with the shop, in person.

1. Browse the catalogue

A customer looks through categories and designs on the shop's own catalogue site, from any phone or computer.

2. Shortlist a design

Photos, weight range and making details help them pick a few designs worth a visit.

3. They contact the shop

By phone, WhatsApp or the contact form below, mentioning the designs they liked.

4. Visit and buy

At the shop, staff pull up the exact pieces in JB One, confirm weight and price on the day, and complete the sale at the counter.

JB Catalogue never takes payment or stock out online — every sale is still made, weighed and billed at the shop.

Part of JB One

The counter app and the catalogue, together

JB Catalogue is the web half of JB One. The mobile app prints tags and prepares estimates at the counter; the catalogue puts the same shop online. Use one, or both.

Questions

Good to know

Is this a marketplace with other shops on it?

No. JB Catalogue is your own website, at your own address, with only your products.

Can customers buy online from the catalogue?

Browsing and enquiries work out of the box. Online ordering is optional and switched on per shop.

Where does the gold rate come from?

A live rate strip reads a public gold and silver rate, shown on the catalogue for reference.

Is our data private?

Yes. See the JB One privacy policy, which covers the catalogue too.

Can I use my own domain?

Yes, your own domain or a subdomain, set up by {{company.name}}.

Does it work with JB One's mobile app?

Yes — they are two halves of the same product. Use the app for the counter, the catalogue for customers online.
